context: Friends complain about bad weather ruining plans
purpose: Commiserate over weather; teach ひどい/前後/当初/させる/かける/聴く/そろそろ/至っ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近ひどい雨が続きますね。
lines.style: weary friend grumbling about weather, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ほんとに。前後の予定が全部狂って。
lines.en: Truly. All my surrounding plans got thrown off.
lines.style: frustrated mother venting about disruption, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 当初は旅行のはずだったのに。
lines.en: It was supposed to be a trip at first.
lines.style: disappointed friend recalling the plan, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子どもにも我慢させる日々で。
lines.en: I make the kids put up with it day after day.
lines.style: apologetic mother feeling the strain, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 気をかけるのもほどほどにね。
lines.en: Do not fret over it too much.
lines.style: caring friend offering gentle advice, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 音楽でも聴くと気が紛れるかしら。
lines.en: Maybe listening to music would distract me.
lines.style: wistful mother seeking small comfort, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そろそろ晴れるといいね。
lines.en: I hope it clears up soon.
lines.style: hopeful friend looking ahead, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 天気予報では、ようやく回復に至ったみたい。
lines.en: On the forecast it seems to have finally turned around.
lines.style: relieved mother sharing the good sign
